claim: Every MCP credential on this machine is held by KAI as a reference and reported only as a presence state. No secret value appears anywhere in this file.
method: KAI's real registry/serverView credentialReport (keys/kind/target/status) for each discovered server; KAI's real secrets.ts resolver for the Windows Credential Manager targets; discord connected live with the reference resolved.

valueHandling.storage: A stored secret is a REFERENCE (env:NAME | credman:TARGET) or, only if a human typed it into KAI directly, a literal. References are inert at rest.
valueHandling.resolution: Resolved only at server-launch time by the one privileged caller (credentialsFor). Fails closed with AGENT_AUTH_FAILED (never an empty string).
valueHandling.reporting: credentialReport returns key NAME, kind, target NAME and status. valuesIncluded is false by construction.

assertion.note: Only key names, reference targets and presence states were ever written. The resolver's value is captured in memory by the one privileged caller and never logged.
